name: vibecoolertunes
description: Audible, semantically distinct notification tones for Claude Code.

plugins.name: notification-tones
plugins.description: Distinct musical tones for each reason Claude Code stops, so you can tell from another room whether it finished, needs permission, or is waiting on an answer.

plugins.name: turn-timeline
plugins.description: Adds the wall-clock range to Claude Code's turn output, so you see not just how long a turn took but from when to when. Includes a /timeline report over any past session.
